I lost $40k on paid ads before I learned this about B2B demand.

We had a great product. We had budget. We still could not book calls.

The problem was not the ads. It was the order.

We went cold before anyone knew our name.

So we flipped it. Warm first, then reach out.

Here is the 5-step system we use now:

1. Map the 50 accounts that fit our price.

2. Warm them for 2 weeks with useful posts.

3. Send a short note that adds value, not a pitch.

4. Book the call when they reply, not before.

5. Track reply rate every single week.

The shift was not subtle. It was loud.

Reply rate went from 9% to 47% in 30 days.

Cost per booked call dropped by 3x.

And the calls were warmer, since they already knew us.

Most teams skip the warming step. They think it is slow.

But cold-first is what makes the whole funnel slow.

You are not short on leads. You are short on trust.

Build the trust first, and the leads stop running away.

Save this post if you sell to other businesses. You will want the 5 steps later.
